name: Funding carry — short perp leg (positive funding received)
rationale: Mirror of the long-spot leg (funding-carry-long-spot.json). When perpetual funding is positive, SHORTS receive the carry premium that longs pay — the short perp leg of a long-spot/short-perp delta-neutral pair. Held standalone this is a directional short with a carry tailwind: it makes money if price falls OR stays flat (funding income offsets mild price appreciation). The funding_feature field accrues the point-in-time periodic funding rate as positive P&L on the short position each bar. Entry: funding above a fitted floor AND price NOT in a strong uptrend (a violent trending move is the short's adversary). Exit: funding flips negative (the carry reverses, unwind immediately via signal_exit) or the stop/TP fires. Basis risk: if spot and perp prices diverge (basis gap), the stop limits loss; basis-gap stop will be enforced at the risk layer (P1.2) when it lands. No magic numbers — every threshold is in param_space.
catalyst: Positive perpetual funding = longs paying carry to shorts; short perp RECEIVES that premium each bar.
